vetSays.line: ★ IDENTIFIED: European Elder. Elder. Big shrub; flat white flower plates in June, drooping black berry clusters in late summer. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
Aki was watching. Now they know European Elder too.
📚 Village knowledge: Åse taught everyone about European Elder. The Codex grows without you lifting a finger.
The fire burns low. 2 new lines in the journal tonight — loudest: European Elder — named and noted.
🛡️ Esmeralda, Jian, Eun-ji, Åse and Aki met them at the door — 5 put down. Esmeralda, Jian, Eun-ji, Åse, Aki are hurt.
Åse showed Wei the European Elder — "remember it." Word travels before the lesson cools.
Petra showed Ivy the European Elder — "remember it." The haven hears about it by supper.
Ruby showed Jian the European Elder — "remember it." Word travels before the lesson cools.
Devon showed Eun-ji the European Elder — "remember it." Word gets around.
Aki showed Elias the European Elder — "remember it." The haven hears about it by supper.
Åse drew European Elder in the dirt for the others. It'll wash away. The knowledge won't.
🛡️ Esmeralda, Eun-ji and Åse met them at the door — 3 put down. Esmeralda, Eun-ji, Åse are hurt.
🌿 European Elder — the foragers have handled it 8 days running. They know it now — which parts are worth hauling, which bruise, how it wants to be carried. The village's knowledge deepens.
💡 European Elder: the village knows more than you do. Harvest it a few more times (0/3) and it'll click.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Esmeralda just put down The Redactor... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Eun-ji just put down Buffering... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Esmeralda, Jian and Eun-ji met them at the door — 2 put down, 1 driven off. Esmeralda is hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Eun-ji just put down The Callback... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Miguel just put down The Ugly Beast... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Jian just put down The Terms of Service... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Jian just put down The Suburb... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "You've gotten too big for the story. Ratings are GREAT, by the way — but you're threatening the narrative now. So the narrative is fighting back. Meet the PRODUCERS."
Blooded — the village knows where the Producers bleed. (Strikes hit 1.5× as hard; their blows land at 0.75× strength.)

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
